_comment: Self-announce traffic for UNCONTROLLED aerodromes (CTAF/AFIS). There is no controller here — these are blind position calls other VFR aircraft make on the field frequency (addressed to '<field> Traffic'). One aircraft per interaction, pilot-only lines, no ATC reply. Rendered with {atc_callsign}='<field> Traffic', {callsign}, {runway}. Played while you're at or just departing an uncontrolled field in a flight plan.
